history.overview: The Sanctum was built as the ceremonial and strategic heart of the Interior Citadel.

timeline.name: Sanctum Foundation
timeline.description: Dragorn slaves carved the initial sanctum chamber.

timeline.name: Banner Hall Construction
timeline.description: Muramite banners were installed to signify military dominance.

timeline.name: Ward Installation
timeline.description: Inquisitors embedded Discord wards into the archways.

timeline.name: Command Ritual Era
timeline.description: Officers began performing command rites on the sanctum dais.
